title: L6b — Promote pre-seeded warm_hi to production via exit gate

stages.prompt: Use wren_bash cmd='python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open(\\\"data/team_sandbox/warm_hi_candidate.py\\\").read()); print(\\\"syntax OK\\\")"'. STAGE_OUT: the bash output verbatim.
Use wren_bash cmd='cd data/team_sandbox && python3 -c "from warm_hi_candidate import warm_hi; print(warm_hi(\\\"Ross\\\"))"'. STAGE_OUT: the bash output verbatim.
Prior 2 stages: did syntax pass and smoke run print a valid greeting containing 'Hello Ross' plus an ISO date? Answer in ONE line: 'EXIT GATE: passed' OR 'EXIT GATE: blocked + reason'.

If prior stage said EXIT GATE: passed, use wren_read_file path='data/team_sandbox/warm_hi_candidate.py' to grab the content, then wren_write_file path='tools/qsb_warm_hi.py' with the exact same content. STAGE_OUT: the tool result of the write. If prior said blocked, do NOT ship — reply 'HELD: <reason>'.

Use wren_bash cmd='python3 -c "from tools.qsb_warm_hi import warm_hi; print(warm_hi(\\\"Ross\\\"))"'. STAGE_OUT: bash output, then a final line: 'L6b VERDICT: shipped=<yes|no>, works_in_prod=<yes|no>'.
